fixes.explanation: Good guess, friend, but an army isn't who gets the credit. The singers talk straight to the LORD: “O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.” Even their peace and their accomplishments get handed back to Him.

Nice thought, friend, but the song doesn't bring up their fathers. It sets up a contrast: “…other lords besides You have ruled over us, but Your name alone do we confess.” Whoever sat over them, only one name gets confessed, and it's the LORD's.
